channel.title: Pier & Point · MB4E
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for MB4E (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · MB4E: MB4E's Phase I construction start remains expected for early 2027, now with the developer's condition: 'Pending financing availability'.
item.description: MB4E's Phase I construction start remains expected for early 2027, now with the developer's condition: 'Pending financing availability'. Source: mb4e.com (developer's project page).

item.title: Correction · MB4E: MB4E's Phase I (early 2027) and Phase II (2028) construction starts were listed twice on Coming up. Each now appears once, citing the developer's project page, which says both depend on financing.
item.description: MB4E's Phase I (early 2027) and Phase II (2028) construction starts were listed twice on Coming up. Each now appears once, citing the developer's project page, which says both depend on financing. Source: https://www.mb4e.com/.

item.title: Correction · MB4E: A link to a City forecast document that no longer opens was removed. The construction start dates come from the developer's own site.
item.description: A link to a City forecast document that no longer opens was removed. The construction start dates come from the developer's own site. Source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, MB4E project page (https://www.mb4e.com/).
item.source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, MB4E project page (https://www.mb4e.com/)

item.title: Correction · MB4E: Block 4-East's notes and summary said it sits on a currently active surface parking lot and is administratively separate from the Mission Rock masterplan; no cited document states either, so the first is now labelled an on-site observation and the second was removed. The fronting streets and the roughly 1,253 sq ft retail space are now attributed to the April 2026 Notice of Exemption (the 2025 press article gave 1,280), the 1290 3rd St address to DataSF Parcels, and the Phase I and II construction starts are shown as 2027 and 2028 (Q1 each, per the developer's site) instead of months from a forecast PDF that could not be read.
item.description: Block 4-East's notes and summary said it sits on a currently active surface parking lot and is administratively separate from the Mission Rock masterplan; no cited document states either, so the first is now labelled an on-site observation and the second was removed. The fronting streets and the roughly 1,253 sq ft retail space are now attributed to the April 2026 Notice of Exemption (the 2025 press article gave 1,280), the 1290 3rd St address to DataSF Parcels, and the Phase I and II construction starts are shown as 2027 and 2028 (Q1 each, per the developer's site) instead of months from a forecast PDF that could not be read. Source: OCII, Notice of Exemption: The Mission Bay South Block 4-East Project, 2026-04-14 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json); Mission Bay 4 East Associates, project site (https://www.mb4e.com/).
item.source: OCII, Notice of Exemption: The Mission Bay South Block 4-East Project, 2026-04-14 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json); Mission Bay 4 East Associates, project site (https://www.mb4e.com/)

item.title: Correction · MB4E: Block 4 East's site label normalized to 'Mission Bay South,' matching the one-label-per-site convention.
item.description: Block 4 East's site label normalized to 'Mission Bay South,' matching the one-label-per-site convention. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Milestone · MB4E: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for the Block 4-East project (statutory exemption under AB 1449 / Public Resources Code section 21080.40, the 100%-affordable-housing exemption). All residential units are restricted to 70% AMI or below (excluding 4 manager units). (Apr 14, 2026)
item.description: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for the Block 4-East project (statutory exemption under AB 1449 / Public Resources Code section 21080.40, the 100%-affordable-housing exemption). All residential units are restricted to 70% AMI or below (excluding 4 manager units). (Apr 14, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14.

item.title: Milestone · MB4E: OCII Commission Resolution No. 02-2026 authorizes commitment of approximately $89,600,000 in permanent gap loan funds for Phase I (165 units); the concurrent Resolution No. 03-2026 authorizes a separate $5,000,000 Phase I predevelopment loan agreement. A related Resolution No. 04-2026 covers a Phase II predevelopment loan (not independently detailed here). (Feb 3, 2026)

item.title: Planned · MB4E: Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Block 4 East (APN 8711-029, west side of 3rd St between Mission Rock and China Basin St -- the site later developed as MB4E) among the Mission Bay South Affordable Housing Parcels obligated under the 1998 Owner Participation Agreement, years before the current MB4E project's design/entitlement phase (Dec 2015)
item.description: Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Block 4 East (APN 8711-029, west side of 3rd St between Mission Rock and China Basin St -- the site later developed as MB4E) among the Mission Bay South Affordable Housing Parcels obligated under the 1998 Owner Participation Agreement, years before the current MB4E project's design/entitlement phase (Dec 2015). Source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan (Successor Agency to the SF Redevelopment Agency, Dec 2015; sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).
